title: Bionano Genome Mapping from Animal Tissue
author: Graham J Etherington
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bd7ei9je
materials: Chef Mammalian Genomic DNA Plug Kit

The animal tissue sample was cut up into <3mm pieces for homogenisation and then fixed in a 2% formaldehyde solution in kit-provided Homogenisation Buffer (HB) for 00:30:00 On ice before blending using a Qiagen Tissueruptor.
One plug of around 90 µL was cast using the Chef Mammalian Genomic DNA Plug Kit (Bio-Rad 170-3591).
Once cooled to 4 °C the plug was added to a lysis solution containing 200 µL proteinase K (QIAGEN 158920) and 2.5 mL of Bionano lysis Buffer.
This was incubated at 50 °C for 02:00:00 in a thermomixer, making a fresh proteinase K solution and incubating Overnight .
The 50 mL tubes were then removed from the thermomixer for 00:05:00 before 50 µL RNAse A (Qiagen158924) was added and to the tubes, returned to the thermomixer for a further hour at 37 °C .
After 00:45:00 at 43 °C the melted plug was dialysed on a 0.1 uM membrane (Millipore VCWP04700) sitting in 15 mL of 1xTE buffer in a small petri dish.
300 ng of DNA was taken into the NLRS (Nick, Label, Repair and Stain) reaction using 1 µL Nt.BspQI (NEB R0644S). The optical maps were then generated using the Bionano Irys platform.

steps.title: Collect DNA from ethanol sample
steps.instruction: Take approximately 10 mg of DNA (extracted from a polecat) from the sample stored in 100 % ethanol.

steps.title: Run IrysPrep Tissue DNA isolation
steps.instruction: Follow the IrysPrep Animal Tissue DNA Isolation from Fibrous Tissue protocol using the IrysPrep Animal Tissue DNA kit (catalog RE‑013‑10, Bionano Genomics).

steps.title: Centrifuge and resuspend in HB buffer
steps.instruction: Spin the preparation at 1500 × g for 00:05:00, remove the supernatant, and resuspend the pellet in approximately 50 µL of HB buffer with a wide‑bore tip to reach a final volume of 66 µL.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend in ~50 µL HB buffer using a wide‑bore tip; adjust to 66 µL total volume.

steps.title: Melt agarose and embed cells
steps.instruction: Melt 40 µL of LMP agarose at 70 °C, cool the melt to 43 °C, add it to the cell resuspension, and mix gently with a wide‑bore tip.

steps.title: Wash plugs with buffers
steps.instruction: Wash the agarose plugs seven times with the Wash Buffer supplied in the Chef kit, then wash seven times with 1× TE buffer.

substeps.instruction: Perform 7 washes using the Chef kit Wash Buffer.

steps.title: Melt plug and add GELase
steps.instruction: Remove the plug, melt it for 00:02:00 at 70 °C, then for 00:05:00 at 43 °C, and add 10 µL of 0.2 U/µL GELase (Cambio Ltd, catalog G31200).

substeps.instruction: Add 10 µL of 0.2 U/µL GELase (Cambio Ltd G31200).

steps.title: Incubate, store overnight, and QC
steps.instruction: After a 00:45:00 incubation, remove the sample with a wide‑bore tip, mix gently for another 00:45:00, then leave the preparation overnight at 4 °C. Finally, take a small aliquot for quality control on an Opgen Argus Q‑Card and Qubit HS to determine DNA concentration.

substeps.instruction: Remove sample with wide‑bore tip and mix gently for 45 minutes.
Take a small aliquot for QC on Opgen Argus Q‑Card and Qubit HS to measure DNA concentration.
